topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session, connects it to histopathology practicals, and outlines the learning outcomes.

topics.label: Tumor virology and cellular transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the study of transforming viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established experimental assays for cellular transformation.

topics.label: Classification and mechanisms of cancer genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the major classes of cancer-associated mutations and illustrate their mechanistic actions using the Rb and p53 pathways.

topics.label: Mechanisms and consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the causes of sequence and chromosomal instability, detailing DNA repair deficiencies, mitotic defects, and their cellular consequences.

topics.label: Multi-step progression and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how sequential mutation accumulation and inherited genetic predispositions drive cancer progression.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the presentation, recommends supplementary reading, and previews the upcoming lecture.
